validation_context.scope: Representative bounded synthetic response, not empirical fault validation

flow_reduction.denominator: matched healthy flow at the same time, load and water boundaries, not nameplate flow
flow_reduction.temporal_profile: Step at onset, then held; no claimed degradation rate
flow_reduction.scope: Chiller-only, fixed-pressure boundaries; no pump, valve actuator, ice or damage model

equipment_protection.name: loss_of_charge
equipment_protection.description: Suction superheat above 25 K for five minutes: loss-of-charge protection.

fault_definitions.name: Reduced evaporator water flow
fault_definitions.mechanism: Equivalent hydraulic resistance reduces water flow through the barrel under fixed pressure boundaries. Flow changes the water heat-capacity rate and effective UA, then the coupled refrigerant cycle, compressor controller and protections respond. For a quadratic-only hydraulic law, q/q_healthy = 1 - blockage. SL1-SL4 represent 10/20/30/40% less matched healthy flow, using an RP-1043-inspired operating-flow reference rather than nameplate flow. The same reduced delivery could arise from several upstream causes: this scenario does not identify a failed pump or valve. Freezing and equipment damage are not modelled.
fault_definitions.severity_label: Use calibrated flow level; no required trip or specified time-to-failure

limitations: No failed-pump, valve-actuator or freeze-damage model
Pump vibration remains healthy site replay
Pump power/VSD and water pressures retain matched healthy context; exclude from pump diagnosis
Pump efficiency and plant totals combine context pump power with simulated chiller duty
